claim: Opens local SRT and WebVTT caption files
sandbox: fresh browser context; upload shipped WebVTT and SRT fixtures; assert each parsed cue count, text, and uncertainty mark

claim: Marks source-supplied uncertainty, speaker changes, and chosen terms separately
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert the annotated token, speaker, and chosen term have separate visible semantics

claim: Caption files stay on this device
where: landing facts, player, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; upload both shipped caption formats, play and adjust controls, and assert no file content or outside request is sent

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; wait for the service worker, go offline, reload, and assert the populated player opens

claim: Playback works with Space and arrow keys
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; use Space and ArrowRight; assert playing state and five-second seek

claim: The timer, timeline, cue buttons, and keyboard shortcuts change cues
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; assert timer movement, timeline seeking, and cue-button seeking change the displayed cue

claim: Caption size, uncertainty, speaker, and chosen-term controls are free
where: landing facts, paid tier, terms, README
sandbox: fresh unlicensed browser context; import a caption file and assert all four named controls are available

claim: A ₹499 one-time Sociobot license adds up to five named setup profiles
where: landing paid tier, player, terms, README
sandbox: recorded billing contract and verification response; accept a returned entitlement, save and load five distinct profiles, reject a sixth, and assert merchant and refund copy

claim: License verification sends only the returned license token to the Sociobot billing API
sandbox: record a returned-license verification request; assert one GET to the Sociobot product endpoint with only the encoded token query and no request body

claim: Local audio drives caption timing without being uploaded
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; load the shipped valid WAV, play it, seek its media time across a cue boundary, and assert no outside request

claim: Shows optional microphone captions when the device speech service is available
sandbox: fresh browser context with a fixture SpeechRecognition engine; assert transcript words and supplied confidence render

claim: Keeps display settings and chosen terms in browser storage
sandbox: fresh real-mode browser context; change caption size, reload, and assert the saved value

claim: Demo sample data is isolated, not saved, and discarded on exit
sandbox: preseed every real storage key; open /?demo=1 with a license parameter, exercise Reset and exit, and assert byte-for-byte unchanged real storage with no outside request

claim: The one-click demo opens five realistic timed captions
sandbox: fresh browser context; click the first-screen sample action once and assert five populated timed cues and the demo banner

claim: WebVTT low and numeric confidence tags plus SRT question tags supply uncertainty below 70 percent
sandbox: upload shipped WebVTT fixtures for low, 42, 69, and 70 percent plus an SRT question-tag fixture; assert only values below 70 percent are marked

claim: Does not diagnose hearing loss
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the boundary and caption controls instead of any diagnosis result

claim: Does not extract video or protected captions
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the boundary and that the only caption import accepts local SRT and WebVTT files

claim: Does not invent confidence scores
sandbox: fresh browser context; upload an ordinary WebVTT fixture without annotations and assert no uncertainty mark

claim: Has no analytics, advertising, accounts, or tracking cookies
sandbox: fresh browser context; visit landing and demo, assert all requests are same-origin and there are no cookies or account controls

claim: Version tags build unsigned macOS, Windows, and Linux packages with SHA256SUMS and latest.json
sandbox: read the release workflow; fetch the latest public GitHub release; assert all platforms and download both release metadata files with checksum entries

claim: The Install page reads the GitHub release API and links to the release page when it fails
sandbox: record the requested GitHub API URL, serve a release fixture, then return 503 and assert the fallback points to a live release page
